en_title: James Gunn and Peter Safran Are Stepping Down From DC Studios in Shock Development That Sparks All Sorts of Questions About the DCU
cn_title: 詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰将卸任DC Studios职务，这一令人震惊的变动引发了有关DCU的种种疑问
opus_summary: Skydance证实，James Gunn与Peter Safran将于12月1日卸任DC Studios联合首席执行官，由前Marvel高管Jeremy Latcham接任。两人仍将负责《Man of Tomorrow》的后期制作，并担任《蝙蝠侠2》等已全面开展项目的制片人。

paragraphs.en: DC Studios heads James Gunn and Peter Safran are stepping down from their roles as co-CEOs, with Skydance tapping an ex-Marvel exec to take over their duties.
paragraphs.cn: DC Studios负责人詹姆斯·古恩和彼得·萨夫兰将卸任联席首席执行官职务，Skydance已选定一名前漫威高管接替他们的工作。

paragraphs.en: Skydance confirmed the news in a press release, revealing that Gunn and Safran's last day as studio heads will be on December 1. Former Marvel exec Jeremy Latcham will replace them. Gunn and Safran are still overseeing post-production on Man of Tomorrow, which is directed by the former. They will also remain producers on other DC projects that are already in full swing, such as The Batman Part 2.
paragraphs.cn: Skydance在一份新闻稿中证实了这一消息，透露古恩和萨夫兰担任制片厂负责人的最后一天将是12月1日。前漫威高管Jeremy Latcham将接替他们。古恩和萨夫兰仍在监督由古恩执导的《Man of Tomorrow》的后期制作。他们也将继续担任其他已经全面展开的DC项目的制片人，例如《新蝙蝠侠Part 2》。

paragraphs.en: “James and Peter launched a new era for DC Studios and led it through a period of real transformation, resetting the foundation and building a slate we’re incredibly proud of," said David Ellison, Chairman and CEO, and Ynon Kreiz, Co-CEO, of Skydance in a joint statement.
paragraphs.cn: Skydance董事长兼首席执行官David Ellison和联席首席执行官Ynon Kreiz在一份联合声明中表示：「詹姆斯和彼得为DC Studios开启了一个新时代，带领它经历了一段真正的转型时期，重建了基础，并打造了一份令我们无比自豪的作品阵容。」

paragraphs.en: "We’re grateful for their passion, contributions and commitment to this legendary brand. Jeremy has been a longtime creative partner to both, and we have complete confidence that James and Peter will ensure a smooth, collaborative transition and continue this work with care. We look forward to working with Jeremy to build the next generation of DC storytelling and to doubling down on our commitment to fans.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们感谢他们对这一传奇品牌倾注的热情、作出的贡献和付出的努力。Jeremy长期以来一直是他们两人的创作伙伴，我们完全相信，詹姆斯和彼得将确保交接顺利、协作进行，并继续用心做好这项工作。我们期待与Jeremy合作，打造新一代DC故事，并加倍履行我们对粉丝的承诺。」

paragraphs.en: Gunn and Safran also issued their own joint statement, acknowledging they have a history with Latcham from Gunn's days at Marvel.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩和萨夫兰也发表了自己的联合声明，提到他们与Latcham的交情可以追溯到古恩在漫威工作时期。

paragraphs.en: “Four years ago, we set out to unite DC under one creative vision," said the duo. "In that time, we helped restore Superman to the heart of DC, while opening new doors and telling new stories in film and television with Peacemaker, Creature Commandos, Lanterns and Clayface. We’re immensely proud of the team that turned that ambition into something real, including the actors, crews and executives we had the opportunity to collaborate with.
paragraphs.cn: 两人表示：「四年前，我们着手以统一的创作愿景整合DC。在此期间，我们帮助超人重回DC的核心，同时通过《和平使者》《生物突击队》《Lanterns》和《Clayface》，在电影和电视领域开启新机遇、讲述新故事。我们为将这一抱负化为现实的团队感到无比自豪，其中包括有机会与我们合作的演员、工作人员和高管。

paragraphs.en: "We’ve shared a creative history with Jeremy going back to Marvel, and we’re eager to see the perspective he brings to DC’s next chapter. We’re excited to return to what drew us to this job in the first place, which is telling the stories we love, including the next chapter of Clark and Lex’s journey in Man of Tomorrow.”
paragraphs.cn: 「我们与Jeremy的创作合作可以追溯到漫威时期，我们迫切期待看到他为DC的下一篇章带来怎样的视角。我们很高兴能够重新回到最初吸引我们从事这份工作的事情上，那就是讲述我们热爱的故事，包括克拉克和莱克斯在《Man of Tomorrow》中旅程的下一篇章。」

paragraphs.en: Gunn and Safran's exit comes as a big surprise, and will likely raise eyebrows across the entertainment industry. Although the press release states they are "stepping away," it's hard not to read between the lines. Just last month, it was reported that the two were safe following the merger approval between Paramount and WB. The merger has led to a lot of key Warner Bros. talent being let go, including executives Pam Abdy and Michael De Luca, who were responsible for curating the studio's line-up of film releases. The news of Gunn and Safran's exit will likely only fuel speculation that they were pushed out by new leadership.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩和萨夫兰的离任令人十分意外，也很可能让整个娱乐业感到惊讶。尽管新闻稿称他们是「离任」，但人们很难不从字里行间揣测其含义。就在上个月，还有报道称，在Paramount与华纳兄弟的合并获批后，两人的职位是安全的。这次合并导致华纳兄弟许多关键人才被解雇，其中包括负责规划该制片厂电影发行阵容的高管Pam Abdy和迈克尔·德·卢卡。古恩和萨夫兰离任的消息很可能只会助长有关他们被新领导层挤走的猜测。

paragraphs.en: Gunn and Safran had a roughly 10-year plan for the DCU, and we're not even halfway through it and the two are already out the door. By all intents and purposes, the two have only recently suggested that they were continuing to plan out the future of DC. Gunn recently released a podcast talking about what's canon and what's not in the DC Universe , he stated that they are planning to cast their new Batman soon , and emphasized importance on Batman, Superman, and Wonder Woman anchroing this universe . These are not the kinds of words and conversations you'd expect from someone who knows they are going to leave.
paragraphs.cn: 古恩和萨夫兰曾为DCU制定了一个大约10年的计划，而如今计划还未过半，两人就已经要离开了。从各方面来看，两人直到最近还在表示，他们仍在继续规划DC的未来。古恩最近发布了一期播客，讨论DC宇宙中哪些内容属于正史、哪些不属于；他表示，他们计划很快为新版蝙蝠侠选角，并强调了蝙蝠侠、超人和神奇女侠作为这个宇宙核心的重要性。这些话语和讨论不像是出自一个知道自己即将离开的人。

paragraphs.en: Additionally, it's hard not to recontextualize the rumors that Robert Pattinson is in the mix for James Bond following this news. Although The Batman films are not in the DCU, they are overseen by DC Studios. Given the development troubles and set backs for The Batman Part 2 , it's possible that higher-ups at Skydance aren't willing to go through all of this again on a potential third film and they likely want to have one, unified universe to avoid audience confusion.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，在这一消息传出后，人们很难不重新审视有关罗伯特·帕丁森是詹姆斯·邦德人选之一的传闻。虽然《新蝙蝠侠》系列电影不属于DCU，但它们由DC Studios监督。考虑到《新蝙蝠侠Part 2》在开发中遇到的麻烦和挫折，Skydance高层可能不愿意在潜在的第三部电影上再次经历这一切，而且他们很可能希望拥有一个统一的宇宙，以免观众感到困惑。

paragraphs.en: Regardless of the truth behind Gunn and Safran's departure, their DC tenure was full of ups and downs. Superman was a hit, though has its fair share of detractors who think it's too silly and overstuffed with extra characters. The universe's second film, Supergirl, was a catastrophic bomb . Clayface appears to be a win thanks to its modest budget , despite a somewhat tepid response from critics. Lanterns and Peacemaker were also solid expansions on the TV side of the DCU.
paragraphs.cn: 无论古恩和萨夫兰离任背后的真相如何，他们在DC任职期间都充满了起伏。《超人》取得了成功，但也有不少批评者认为影片过于愚蠢，并塞入了太多额外角色。这个宇宙的第二部电影《超级少女》则遭遇了灾难性的惨败。尽管影评人的反响有些冷淡，《Clayface》凭借适中的预算似乎取得了成功。《Lanterns》和《和平使者》也是DCU在电视领域扎实的拓展。

paragraphs.en: However, the universe has had a difficult time creating momentum. After four years, we really have no idea what's going on with Batman. Wonder Woman is a big question mark. There's been questions over whether or not we'll get a Justice League movie. And other projects that were announced at the outset of this universe, such as Swamp Thing , have seemingly completely stalled out. It hasn't been a disaster, but it definitely seems like things could've been better. Whether the new DC Studios leadership can get a better handle on things remains to be seen.
paragraphs.cn: 然而，这个宇宙一直难以形成发展势头。四年过去了，我们真的不知道蝙蝠侠的情况究竟如何。神奇女侠也是一个大问号。人们一直在问，我们是否会看到一部正义联盟电影。而这个宇宙启动之初宣布的其他项目，例如《Swamp Thing》，似乎已经完全停滞。情况算不上灾难，但事情显然本可以进展得更好。DC Studios的新领导层能否更好地掌控局面，还有待观察。
